front.title: An Agent-Channel Frame for Identity-Keyed Fan-Out Delivery to Concurrent Sessions

abstract.t: This memo specifies a message envelope, a recipient-scope grammar and a subscribe-filter grammar for delivering short structured messages to the concurrent sessions of one identity. A sender names a set of recipients by identity shape, such as all sessions of one handle or all sessions whose instrument identifier has a given prefix, and a delivery server expands that set against live subscriptions at delivery time. Frames are emitted over a per-handle Server-Sent Events stream. The envelope carries a kind discriminator whose set of values is open. The memo defines three kinds, and other documents may define more. The memo specifies the wire elements only; frame retention is out of scope.
